guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not trade evidence completeness, deterministic isolation, or coverage for speed.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: All 21 quality gates, the 85.10% executable coverage floor, JUnit, timing, logs, supply-chain checks, installation smoke, and terminal CI evidence remain enforced.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Optimize measured structural costs before adding concurrency.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: The implementation prunes installer history traversal, caches immutable inventory, and parallelizes only independent hosted Jobs; pytest high concurrency was not enabled.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Treat archived template-maintenance history separately from adopter runtime payload and document the boundary.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Installer tests prove active/archive/starts/decisions history is excluded while skeleton, policies, baselines, adoption, upgrade, and governance journeys remain covered.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use source-bound, like-for-like hosted evidence and record failed performance targets honestly.

risk.detail: The structural optimization is proven on three hosted runs and preserves all governed gates, but project-test still takes about 10 minutes 40 seconds and runner/test-growth variability remains. Release publication is out of scope.

observedIssues.fact: A medium-risk code Contract with five explicit required scenarios, no unknowns, concrete acceptance, implementation capability, and executionDecision=continue remained needs_human_confirmation solely because the scenarios were unverified before implementation. Recording the user-authorized Decision Evidence changed the state to human_decision_recorded, which the enforced policy also blocks; no valid transition to ready exists without falsely marking implementation-dependent scenarios verified.
observedIssues.decision: Stop further performance implementation, preserve the current branch unchanged, and complete a separate corrective Work Item that distinguishes concrete planned verification from missing or ambiguous scenario coverage.
observedIssues.resolution: Resolved by corrective Work Item preflight-planned-scenario-transition-20260728 and merged PR #412; planned scenarios can authorize implementation only with concrete expected results and verification plans, while finish remains fail closed until evidence is verified.
observedIssues.followUp: The resumed performance Contract passed enforced Preflight and all five required scenarios now carry real implementation and hosted evidence.

observedIssues.fact: After PR #412 and PR #413 closed the performance Work Item prerequisites, the paused branch rebased cleanly to origin/main f6b12629 and Preflight derived ready with five planned scenarios. The immutable Start Receipt still binds the original base f00ac8b3, while the Contract must record the new branch base; validate_receipt rejects the mismatch and the repository provides no governed rebase/resume receipt lineage.
observedIssues.decision: Pause performance implementation again and complete a dedicated corrective that preserves the immutable original receipt while adding a source-bound resume/rebase lineage accepted only after predecessor closure.
observedIssues.resolution: Resolved by work-item-resume-receipt-lineage-20260728 in merged PR #414 and schema alignment in merged PR #417; the immutable Start Receipt is retained and three generated resumeHistory edges bind each new base to a closed predecessor.
observedIssues.followUp: The final resume edge to 5e7c9d2d passed Contract validation and Preflight before implementation resumed.

observedIssues.fact: The first measurement snapshot quality run treated the documented command make -n quality as a reference to a nonexistent Make target named -n and stopped before heavy tests.
observedIssues.decision: Fix the parser with a red-first regression so recognized no-argument dry-run options are skipped and the real target remains checked; do not hide the defect by rewriting the documentation.
observedIssues.resolution: The focused regression and make check-ai-system-invariants pass with the corrected parser.
observedIssues.followUp: Keep future option forms explicit; options that consume arguments require separate parser coverage before use in documented command extraction.

observedIssues.fact: The snapshot command-line CONTRACT override propagated through GNU Make into pytest and then into nested adopter make processes, causing three lifecycle tests to select the template performance Contract instead of each adopter's local e2e Contract.
observedIssues.decision: Sanitize parent Make and Work Item override variables only at the isolated snapshot quality subprocess boundary; preserve the rest of the hosted/local execution environment.
observedIssues.resolution: The environment regression and all three previously failing lifecycle tests pass together.
observedIssues.followUp: The complete f9e1b7e4 snapshot passed 1293 tests and all three hosted measurements passed on the sanitized boundary.

observedIssues.fact: Hosted run 30324321071 bound to ef9d54dc completed template-smoke quality in 10 minutes 53 seconds and installation-smoke in 15 seconds, but workflow_dispatch was unconditionally classified as release preparation, so release-evidence failed on unrelated historical release-state drift and the aggregate correctly failed.
observedIssues.decision: Add an explicit manual-dispatch purpose choice, preserve release_preparation as the strict default, and require hosted_measurement for non-release source-bound performance runs.
observedIssues.resolution: Workflow and tests separate manual hosted measurement from release preparation; runs 30325316583, 30325920850, and 30326505323 all completed release-evidence as successful not-applicable ownership checks and ci-evidence as success.
observedIssues.followUp: Run 30324321071 remains diagnostic only and is excluded from the three-run statistics.
